subject: Ability estimation and next item selection methods  for the multidimensional items

messages.author: 84aac2580b195c68
messages.subject: Ability estimation and next item selection methods  for the multidimensional items
parts:
Hello Phil,


We know that mirt() function estimates parameters of all kinds of items (unidimensional( dichotomous and polytomous) as well as  multidimensional). 

There is package called catR which has function like thetaEst and nextItem which help to estimate the ability and next item  for unidimensional (dichotomous and polytomous ) items respectively. ( Reference: http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/catR/catR.pdf )

Does there exist any package in R which will able to estimate the ability and next item  for the multidimensional  items whose parameters are estimated by mirt() function?



P.S. I was thinking fscores is the function which can estimate the ability same as that thetaEst in catR function but later I found out that former one uses summed score to estimate thetas unlike thetaEst which uses response pattern.


Regards,
Irshad

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Ability estimation and next item selection methods for the multidimensional items
parts:
You may want to check out the mirtCAT package, especially the development version on Github. A paper about the package is under review, and when it's accepted will be shipped with the package. The package itself goes one step further than catR in that it can actually generate CAT tests in a web browser for local and remote administrations, in addition to running simulation based designs. Cheers.

Phil
